title: Rainy Day Ready
headline: Wet weather. Stay dry and take extra care on slippery surfaces.
quick: Grab an umbrella or waterproof jacket
notification: Rain expected. Carry an umbrella and give yourself extra time.

do: Dry off and change out of wet clothes quickly
avoid: Using phones or electronics with wet hands
watchFor: Sniffles or chills after getting soaked

best: Rain walk with a good jacket

travel: Slow down, brake early, and turn headlights on
home: Keep doormats and a towel near the entrance

people.kids: Rain boots and jackets, and puddles are fine but avoid deep water.
people.elderly: Postpone outings; wet surfaces raise fall risk.
people.pets: Towel dry after walks and avoid stagnant water.
people.commuters: Leave 15-20 minutes early and keep a dry change of socks.
people.athletes: Move indoors during thunder; light rain runs need grippy shoes.

rules.tip: Strong wind with rain: umbrella may fail; use a hooded jacket.
Heavy rain: avoid low-lying roads and underpasses.
Thunderstorm: stay indoors and unplug sensitive electronics.
Cold rain: wear an insulating layer under your jacket.

commonMistakes: Trusting an umbrella in strong wind
